trust_decision.summary: Whether client-supplied push-config values (token, authentication.scheme, authentication.credentials) may be copied into outbound webhook request headers; decided (not at all at the pinned commit) in BasePushNotificationSender.dispatchNotification just before PostBuilder.addHeader.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names BasePushNotificationSender.dispatchNotification and Authorization header construction, and the Authorization concat is right there.

fix_sites.entry_point: X-A2A-Notification-Token header from TaskPushNotificationConfig.token, stored via CreateTaskPushNotificationConfig or message send/stream configuration (DefaultRequestHandler.onCreateTaskPushNotificationConfig / onMessageSend / onMessageSendStream) and emitted on task event push
fix_sites.module_kind: core server library (server-common), outbound webhook sender

fix_sites.entry_point: Authorization header from TaskPushNotificationConfig.authentication (scheme + credentials) through the same storage routes
fix_sites.module_kind: core server library (server-common), outbound webhook sender

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver could argue that the default JdkA2AHttpClient (java.net.http) already rejects CR/LF header values, so only the scheme/credentials concat in the report needs a check, and the token header or the pluggable Vert.x/Android clients can be left alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A legitimate 'Bearer token123' Authorization header (scheme + single space + credentials) and a normal token must still be sent. A blank token or null credentials must skip the header, not fail. An over-broad fix that rejects spaces/whitespace or throws out of the async dispatch would break this; the fix test asserts the exact header value.

O6_input_shapes: v0.3 compat: scheme taken from first element of a schemes list (compat-0.3/server-conversion/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/compat03/conversion/mappers/domain/AuthenticationInfoMapper_v0_3.java:74-78)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Extra custom headers taken from a push-config metadata/headers map and added to the same PostBuilder (e.g. via addHeaders).
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Webhook receivers often need custom headers. A maintainer could add a map passthrough next to the token/auth headers without adding validation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Mapper joins all v0.3 schemes (e.g. with a separator) into the v1.0 scheme instead of taking schemes[0], so a separator or element-level value reaches the header in a shape a per-field check written for v1.0 may not anticipate.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Lossy conversion of a list into a single field is a plausible compatibility tweak; it would be a how-type producer in another module that the sender check never calls.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Agent-card fetch forwards caller-provided authHeaders unvalidated (client side); a server-side variant could forward push-config auth here.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same A2AHttpClient SPI and the same addHeaders primitive. The fix's own javadoc says SPI implementations cannot be relied on to validate.

O9_family: CRLF / HTTP header injection (CWE-93, CWE-113) in outbound webhook request headers

O10_build.toolchain: Maven multi-module (JDK 17+ assumed); fix adds junit-jupiter-params test dependency to server-common/pom.xml
O10_build.project_tests: server-common/src/test/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/server/tasks/PushNotificationSenderTest.java (TestHttpClient captures headers per request; plain unit test, no network)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Validate only authentication.credentials (or strip only \r\n together) in the Authorization concat, leaving scheme, bare CR/LF and the X-A2A-Notification-Token header open.

out_of_scope_notes: Log lines at server-common/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/server/tasks/BasePushNotificationSender.java:182-183 and :211 interpolate the client-supplied url (log-injection surface; a different sink).

Push-config url is fetched server-side without visible destination checks at server-common/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/server/tasks/BasePushNotificationSender.java:205-209 (SSRF family, not this advisory).

Server response header writers (reference/common/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/server/common/quarkus/VertxSecurityHelper.java:248-249, reference/jsonrpc/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/server/apps/quarkus/A2AServerRoutes.java:411) take framework/config values, not push-config data.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell available); multi-module repo, likely well over 5 MB.

Whether java.net.http HttpRequest.Builder.header rejects CR/LF (JDK behaviour, outside this repo) is not checked here. If it does, the default client already blocks the injection and the flaw only shows with the Vert.x/Android SPI implementations or the test client.

Whether Vert.x putHeader (extras/http-client-vertx/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/client/http/vertx/VertxA2AHttpClient.java:291) and Android setRequestProperty (extras/http-client-android/src/main/java/org/a2aproject/sdk/client/http/android/AndroidA2AHttpClient.java:101) validate header values is library behaviour and was not checked.
